technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present recovery potential, but absence of bullish confirmation signals, negative momentum indicators, and price below all key moving averages make this a low-probability entry without additional bullish catalyst.

fundamental.summary: PM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings volatility in 3 days—fundamentally weak setup.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no influential senior member conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with critical earnings binary event in 3 days create elevated risk environment for PM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold conditions (RSI 9 & 14) combined with fear-zone sentiment (35/100) and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment create contrarian recovery potential if support at 75.31 holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 3 days, crisis-level VIX, price below all major moving averages, negative momentum (MACD, OBV, AO), and zero bullish confirmation signals make this a high-risk, low-probability entry into macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9 & 14) and fear-zone sentiment (35/100) offer contrarian appeal, but critical earnings binary in 3 days combined with price below all major moving averages and zero bullish momentum confirmation create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 3 days creates binary event risk that can gap through support; macro environment (crisis VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve) provides no tailwind for recovery.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; debate decisively favors bear (8 vs 3)
